description: Experimental linear MTP2 with GPU top-eight proposal sampling and maximal coupling against the final filtered target candidates. Model arithmetic and weight formats are unchanged. Coupled rows normalize in FP64 and use 53-bit independent proposal/acceptance/residual streams, rather than the ordinary FP32/24-bit picker; fixed-seed tokens are not preserved. Numerical cancellation samples the FP64 target directly. RADIANCE_NO_DRAFT must be unset. This configuration is not a gate PASS or a performance claim.
